senses.gloss:
नैचाशाख नैचाशाख, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नीचा +
शाखा), Ved. belonging to the low branches of the
community, i. e. belonging to the lower orders or
common people; (अम्), n. (perhaps) low or common
people; (Sāy.) N. of a town.

नैचित्य नैचित्य, अस्, m. a prince of the
Nicitas.

नैचुल नैचुल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-चुल), belong-
ing to or produced by the Barringtonia Acutangula.
